name: Two-Stage Sorting
definition: A sorting strategy that separates the creation of per-tile splat lists into two stages: one to establish depth ordering and a second to obtain per-tile lists, reducing VRAM usage and sorting time compared to single-stage radix sort.
summary: Two-Stage Sorting optimizes volume rendering by splitting depth-sorted per-tile splat list generation into two separate radix sort routines to reduce VRAM usage and computational complexity.
